goal: Investigate whether preserved original Coin Metrics Git commits approximate an uninterrupted 2020-2025 PUBLICATION-CANDIDATE history, not claiming original public push/first-seen. Explicit negative controls 2018/2019. No prediction analysis.

archivalRepoCutoffs.source: Historic Git objects preserved in 2024 fork
Historic Git objects preserved by June 2025 fork

sourceChecks: Fetch most recent Git commit modifying csv/btc.csv at or before Sunday 00:00 UTC from cutoff-appropriate preserved fork; use GitHub REST commit query with path and until <= decision, per_page=1; retain complete original commit SHA and committer UTC.
Verify matching Git tree csv/btc.csv Git blob SHA1 and raw CSV Git SHA1 bytes, no silent replacement.
Check exact observation row from Friday or older 2-7 days before Sunday; no forward filling or date >= Saturday.
Quantify: source recency (committer-to-Sunday days), archive-row age, MVRV column, CapRealUSD and CapMrktCurUSD columns, and arithmetic agreement when all three available.
Forbid upgrading a historical committer date to genuine independent public first-seen or actual provider release. No source can be provider-clock verified with Git commit metadata alone.
Lock baseline 684 weekly panel exactly; audit 26 frozen prechosen samples only (not a complete 684 as-of MVRV panel). Mark source missing, stale, value discrepancy, or API failures separately.
Comparison to 11 independently dated fork witness weeks: unchanged strict count from c8. New historical commit dates are only weaker candidates and NOT allowed as new independently proven PIT weeks.
Raw CoinMetrics CSV CC BY-NC: do not republish full source, save metadata, Git SHA, and only compact fixed observation values.
Do not train models, search cutoffs, examine future price outcomes, infer actionable edge or create trade signal.

evidenceTiers.A: independent public GitHub fork as-of creation/push, previously c8: 11, pinned unchanged
evidenceTiers.B: old original upstream Git committer date with raw Git object verification but first public push moment not independently witnessed; only chronological candidate
evidenceTiers.C: modern data backfilled with no as-of witness; NOT PIT

output: R2 report and SHA256 manifest, 26 frozen dates source audit, per-era summary and non-trading restrictions. Any source error retained, no fabricated PASS.
